summary: The current canonical repository does not expose a verifiable AniWorld provider path even though AniWorld-specific German availability semantics are a protected product invariant.

facts.value: CalendarViewModel and CalendarHostViewModel query MediaRepository.getAiringAnimesPage, backed by AniList AiringAnimesQuery time bounds.
AiringWidget renders AniList nextAiringEpisode and MediaRepository.getAiringWidgetData sorts by nextAiringEpisode.timeUntilAiring.

NotificationWorker polls AniList notifications through NotificationRepository and converts NotificationType.AIRING directly into an Episode X aired notification; this is not proof of German AniWorld availability.

evidence: fresh repository code search for AniWorld and aniworld.to on 2026-08-26

facts.value: Temporary debug and optimized APKs built from source revision 77df4bec747481b2178e3c47f872831bc6af4f83 contain no AniWorld or aniworld.to strings. Extracted network hosts include AniList and MyAnimeList endpoints but no AniWorld host.

The canonical commit history inspected around the 2026-08-05 release and 2026-08-23 upstream sync contains no identifiable AniWorld implementation commit; the old integrated-rebuild tree also contains no AniWorld-named path.

A second forensic pass over surviving recovery/integration refs and PR history found no AniWorld-named source path or implementation commit in recovery/apk-feature-rescue@4e54026b3f83029d97c77354c8a2e8fe588914cb, feature/kiyori-integrated-rebuild@36de346b31d22e0e566601393210e8cb7b423fcd, feature/plan2-recovery-phase3-4@8e37618b25e115e7afae5400709268c4a6ea1aea, or PRs #2 through #10. The preserved LEGACY_RECOVERY_CONTEXT also contains no AniWorld reference. This strengthens the provenance gap but does not prove that an unreachable, deleted-remote, local-only worktree, patch, reflog object or external backup never contained the implementation.
